entities.summary: Ty Jeremy Jerome is an American professional basketball player for the Memphis Grizzlies of the National Basketball Association (NBA). He played college basketball for the Virginia Cavaliers, where in 2019 he was the starting shooting guard on their national championship team. Jerome was drafted by the Philadelphia 76ers in the 2019 NBA draft but was traded to the Phoenix Suns. He has also played for the Oklahoma City Thunder, Golden State Warriors and Cleveland Cavaliers.
